pages: What is it you need?
Is there anything else?
Which one will it be?
No one can equip this, though...
Will you equip it?
Who will equip it?
Which one will you remove?
All things must pass...
You can't carry any more money.
Looks like you have nothing to sell.
Hmph... All talk and no fight, the lot of them...
An annoying interruption, but now the preparations are complete!
Send word to Lady Ushiwaka!
Tell her Edo is hers to carve up as she pleases! Gahahahaha!
Cham Cham got strong!
Never think Cham Cham would save me...
The curtain has fallen on our play...
Oh! Cham Cham, it's a happy ending!
Cham Cham... all your hard work paid off, didn't it?
This sacred stone is Lord Ambra's egg, made of stone!
Sankai Doushi says Lord Ambra is still just an egg.
So that Lord Ambra will be born into this world soon...
...we all pray together like this.
Lord Ambra... please hurry and be born...
In the world Lord Ambra makes, there won't be any samurai, right?
They say samurai are all bad people...
But Mister Jubei, who came by the other day, was nice...
He gave me one of his rice balls!
Mister Jubei said he was climbing Mount Fuji to meet Lord Ambra too!
They say soon we'll get to eat all the white rice we want!
And all the mean samurai who pick on us...
...Lord Ambra's gonna beat 'em all up!
But what's gonna happen to nice samurai...
...like Mister Jubei, I wonder...
I'll let you in on a secret... Edo Castle is gonna fall...
Take my advice...
Put your faith in Lord Ambra and you'll be sitting pretty.
Heh heh heh... Foolish peasants...
Praying away without a clue.
And not just the peasants...
The townsfolk and ronin of Edo too... Our teachings...
...are surely taking root...
And that plan seems to be going smoothly as well...
Hm?
I'm a traveling peddler... No, don't ask about my reasons.
...So, care to buy something?
Lord Ambra, you say?
I hear there's a fanatical group openly calling for the Shogunate's fall.
They swindle farmers and townsfolk out of their money...
...and apparently plan to stir them up into revolt.
Ask Jubei about that. It's precisely his line of duty.
What... Jubei went to Mount Fuji?
The sea of trees at Fuji is a deadly maze. Get lost and you never get out.
If you mean to follow him, prepare yourself well.
I hear the demons there are fierce too. Good luck to you.
Have you found the Palenque Stone?
Hmm... I see...
Have you met the man who calls himself Amakusa?
Have you met Yagyu Jubei? I'm sure he'll be of help.
You said the Palenque is a stone holding divine power...
I hear a man calling himself Amakusa Shiro appeared lately...
They say he carries a jewel imbued with magic power.
The Palenque disappears... and this Amakusa appears...
That man sounds suspicious.
That's about all I can tell you. Hmm...
What, such a thing...
I'd heard a cult worshipping the god Ambra was spreading, but...
...to think they were plotting something so outrageous...
Ukyo, hurry and go see Jubei.
The demon attacks and the spread of the Ambra cult may well be...
...connected by a single thread.
Ah, Ukyo... Good timing. There's something you should hear.
There's a rumor that demons are appearing on Mount Fuji!
You may find some clue about the demon realm around Fuji!
Oh, you're safe... I was worried about you.
What... you say that man truly was Amakusa Shiro?
Amakusa Shiro Tokisada... He led the Shimabara Rebellion 150 years ago...
...the supreme leader of the Christians. Has he returned to this world?
The grudge of a boy who died at just sixteen, cursing this world...
It troubles me...
About the demons and strange incidents stirring up the land...
It seems the evil god called Lord Ambra and Amakusa's ghost are linked.
Ominous rumors are drifting in from the west. Take care if you go.
I found an interesting document.
Two sisters who were said to be at Amakusa's side...
One of them, the younger, was called Lady Toki, it seems.
She fled the rebellion and lived in hiding around Ise.
Lady Toki adored and longed for Amakusa Shiro, but...
...it seems the one Amakusa loved was another princess.
...Ah, love is a difficult thing.
A clan that once designed hidden chapels and forts on Amakusa's orders...
...is said to live there...
They may have something to do with the revived Amakusa's ambitions.
Lady Ten! The other princess was named Lady Ten!
You know, the princess who was with Amakusa!
Lady Ten and Lady Toki... these sisters were rivals in love...
The one Amakusa loved was Lady Ten...
Lady Toki had a sad fate... but Amakusa was an unlucky man too.
Had he lived an ordinary life, he could've been happy with Lady Ten.
From the northern lands, are you? What brings you to this old scholar?
...Hmm, hmm, the demon realm, you say? Hmm...
I hear it's a world of darkness where the Dark Lord and demons dwell...
Honestly, I don't know much myself... Let me see...
Ah, yes, traveler...
You should visit Yagyu Jubei in Edo.
He's survived many a bloody battle against demons...
He may have some information on this man calling himself Amakusa.
From the northern lands, are you? What brings you to this old scholar?
...Hmm, hmm, the demon realm, you say? Hmm...
I hear it's a world of darkness where the Dark Lord and demons dwell...
Honestly, I don't know much myself. Very well, I'll look into it.
Hmmm...
Oh my... A foreign ninja! It pays to live a long life.
What...? Amakusa? Amakusa, Amakusa...
You mean Amakusa Shiro Tokisada...?
If you don't mind, tell me the whole story.
Well, you see...
I see... Hanzo's son, is it...
Hmm, it seems I'll just have to look into it...
Hmmm...
Well, if it isn't Ukyo!
Did you find the gateway to the demon realm?
I hear demons are appearing even out in the fields and hills...
There must be an entrance somewhere...
Hmmm...
Haohmaru! So, has your swordsmanship improved?
Heh heh, you seem a bigger man every time I see you.
Oh my, if it isn't the girl from the north...
So, have you fulfilled this mission of yours?
Ah, the foreign ninja... Welcome.
Ah, Ukyo!
Did you find the gateway to the demon realm?
Ah, the swordsman from before.
Have you found any clues about Amakusa Shiro since then?
Well, well, the girl from before! Full of energy as always.
Did you find the Palenque Stone?
You know Yagyu Jubei, don't you?
Go to the Yagyu residence in Edo and speak with Jubei.
I'm sure he can tell you something about Amakusa and the demon realm.
I'll look through my books as well. Come visit again...
About the demon realm, rather than me...
...Yagyu Jubei of Edo would know far more.
Why not visit Jubei, as your father's last words said?
Just as you say, regarding Amakusa...
...asking Yagyu Jubei would be best.
Go and meet Jubei once.
Have you visited the Yagyu residence in Edo?
Jubei can surely teach you much about the demon realm.
You should visit Yagyu Jubei in Edo.
He's survived many a bloody battle against demons...
He may have some information on this man calling himself Amakusa.
I don't know much about the Palenque Stone, but...
...Yagyu Jubei of Edo may know of some clue.
Go and talk with him. I'm sure he'll be of help.
So Jubei crossed the Hakone checkpoint to Mount Fuji...
The sea of trees at Fuji is a deadly maze. Get lost and you never get out.
If you mean to follow him, prepare yourself well.
I hear the demons there are fierce too. Good luck to you.
...But to think such things happened at Fuji...
I'd heard a cult worshipping the god Ambra was spreading, but...
...to think they were plotting something so outrageous...
You'd best hurry back to Edo and see Jubei.
The demon attacks and the spread of the Ambra cult...
...may well be connected by a single thread.
I hear things got terrible in Edo.
I'm glad you made it out safely...
What... you say that man truly was Amakusa Shiro?
Amakusa Shiro Tokisada... He led the Shimabara Rebellion 150 years ago...
...the supreme leader of the Christians. Has he returned to this world?
The grudge of a boy who died at just sixteen, cursing this world...
It troubles me...
About this Amakusa fellow who's stirring up the land...
I found an interesting document.
Long ago, two sisters served at Amakusa's side...
The younger one was called Lady Toki, it seems.
Lady Toki adored and longed for Amakusa Shiro, but...
...it seems the one Amakusa loved was the other princess.
...Ah, love is a difficult thing.
About Amakusa Shiro, who's stirring up the land...
I've heard a story like this.
A clan that once designed hidden chapels and forts on Amakusa's orders...
...is said to still live in hiding somewhere...
In a village called Cruz, apparently.
It's said to be somewhere to the west, but I don't know exactly where...
Amakusa Shiro's ghost is stirring up the land, but...
I found a document like this.
It's said two princesses were with Amakusa.
Their names were Lady Ten and Lady Toki... Rivals in love, you might say.
Both of them had feelings for Amakusa Shiro.
But the one Amakusa loved was Lady Ten...
A pity for Lady Toki...
But come to think of it, Amakusa was an unlucky man too.
Had he just lived an ordinary life, he could've been happy with Lady Ten.
...In the Shogunate's records he's written up like a demon...
...this Amakusa Shiro, but...
...in truth he was a fine boy, pure, upright and devoted to God.
If this ghost of Amakusa truly is Amakusa Shiro risen again...
...what could have changed him so much, I wonder...
Whew... Security's really tight, eh?
Getting in is one thing, but going back is out of the question.
Anyway, let's go to Edo and talk to Yagyu...
We might learn something about this Amakusa guy.
Ayame said Edo is a big city to the south...
All right, let's go, Poppy!
Checkpoints closed everywhere... business is dead...
...So, how about it? Want to buy some herbs?
1448.question: 20GP apiece. How about it?

pages: Thanks! Watch out for demons!
What... oh, well.
Honestly, what is the Shogunate thinking?
Closing the road all of a sudden... The Shogunate can be so cruel.
Tch, what's the deal?
Oh well. Like my master said, anyway...
...guess I'll go to Edo and hear what that Jubei guy has to say.
Hmph... Very well.
In that case, I'll go to Edo...
...and take a look at the face of this Yagyu Jubei.
Oh, Haohmaru... What's that? You want to go to Edo?
Hahaha, going sightseeing? ...All right, you can pass.
1454.question: Pass Takasaki checkpoint?

pages: Waah, Genjuro! Y-you wanna fight? Huh?
What's that? You want to go to Edo?
All right, all right! Go on, hurry through!
1455.question: Pass Takasaki checkpoint?

pages: Sounds like things are bad in Edo. Save the sightseeing for later.
I see...
But you can't get to Edo without going through here.
Where the hell is this? Damn!
That old man palmed off a rotten tub on me since it was free!
Next time I see him, he's dead!
Cough, cough...
...It seems we survived, everyone.
Where are we?
...Hell, huh...
So what's this Amakusa's Key, anyway?
...That may well be. Now, what is Amakusa's Key?
Legend says the Devil's Horn rock near the docks...
...will be the first to give voice...
I beg you... please save Lord Amakusa's soul!
In the legendary chapel said to lie deep in the crater of Mount Aso...
...there must be something that can save his soul!
Was it good? Feel better now?
You feel a little more spirited!
...They say there's a secret chapel somewhere in Kyushu!
Legend says a princess blessed by God, Lady Ten...
...was going to hold her wedding there.
But she was called to heaven in the Shimabara war before she could marry.
Poor thing...
Okay. I'm ready anytime. Just say when you want to leave the island.
Just so you know, Kurusu is an island of hidden Christians...
Once you cross over to the mainland, you can never come back.
Tasty, wasn't it? Come again!
You feel your strength return!
The one who brought the blessed teachings to this island...
...was a princess with a pure white heart, Lady Ten, they say.
That was over a hundred years ago, though.
Cough, cough...
...It seems we survived, everyone.
But where are we?
Oh!? Are you all alive?!
Yeah! What a nice day, like that storm never happened!
Nkekekeke...
What the...?
What a creepy voice...
That's not the voice of nature... is it?
? Looks like some kind of church, huh?
But that laugh sure sets my justice on fire!
What a strange building...
And eerie laughter from inside... It worries me.
? They got some weird animal locked up in there?
So this is Amakusa's Key...
{NAME}, let's head back to the Elder for now.
We finally found it... Amakusa's Key...
Let's have the Elder look at it first.
Hmm... So this is Amakusa's Key...
OK, anyway, let's have the Elder take a look!
Cough... It seems the legend was true.
In any case, let us return to the Elder.
Hmph... What a lot of running around.
Well, I suppose I'll show it to the Elder...
If it's a fake, this'll have been a fine farce.
Yay! We found it, we found it!
Hey, hey, let's hurry and show the Elder!
So this is the clue to unraveling Amakusa's secret...
{NAME}, let's hear what the Elder has to say first!
Everything else comes after!
My word! So this is Amakusa's Key?
How very mysterious.
For now, let us go to the Elder and hear the details!
Wow... the legend was true! Hey, let's go show the Elder!
Nkeeh! With skills like that, you'd defeat the King of Hell? Don't make me laugh, ke!
You're out of the question, ke!
Train some more before you come challenging Gen'an, ke!
Get to at least LV 17 or so, ke! Kekeke!
What can I do for you?
Is there anything else?
Which one would you like?
No one can equip that.
Thanks be to God... Amen.
You have nothing to sell.
Headed for Mount Aso? Better not.
...These days people call it the devil's mountain...
That was scary... The world's gone mad lately.
Well, why not soak in the hot springs for a while...
Have you heard? Amakusa Shiro has risen again...
...and leads an army of demons.
They say the world's going to change soon...
And it starts here in Kyushu... What could that mean, I wonder?
In the hot spring's steam, for a while I forget my road of carnage...
...your image swaying, drifting by.
With this, you've got nothing to fear in a pinch!
What, you've got no money? That's a shame.
Tasty, right?!
...Taste aside? You feel your spirit rise!
They say the Shogunate's soldiers came here...
...to wipe out the ghost of some Amakusa Shiro-whatsit.
And this is just a rumor too, but...
...between the big storm on the Inland Sea and that one Doushi guy...
...they got pretty much wiped out!
How was it? Tasty, right?!
You feel your strength return!
They say there's a hidden inn on Mount Aso.
But can an inn make any money if it's hidden...?
Oh my... You flew all this way to find me...
Wh-what dangerous times we live in...
Did you know, sir...?
They say things look troubling on Mount Aso too...
Well, then...
For just 20GP, I'll tell your fortune, but good!
1501.question: Get your fortune told?

pages: Aww... You're a real cheapskate, huh?
You say you've got no money?
Then your fortune is the worst!
That aggressive soul... I like it!
But it also means you're close to the darkness...
So be careful, okay?
Is cutting things down really the only way?
You should try living another way too, you know.
Heh heh... You love it, don't you? Fighting...
Your body doesn't lie.
Since when did you become so fierce?
Didn't you used to hate fighting?
You walk the path you must... How wonderful.
So you'll keep fighting until you die.
You'll keep cutting... to the end...
Yes, to the very end.
Even while walking the path of carnage...
...you haven't forgotten what really matters...
Wonderful.
Your kindness... believe it'll be rewarded someday!
You wrap even demons in your warmth, don't you?
...But don't you dare die.
You've turned kindness into strength and power...
Keep it up just a little longer.
Is the person you are now the real you?
But kindness is part of a man's charm, too.
Your kindness... others probably can't see it.
Only I know about it...
I'm heading back to Kurusu now. I won't forget you folks.
There, all done!
Cham Cham won't forgive anyone who picks on animals!
Um... sir...
Free is kind of a problem...
Kyeeei!!
I smell it! The stench of Amakusa! Come out, Amakusa!
Where is Amakusa?! Kyeeei!
Sankai! Gokai! Big brothers, I did it!
I got revenge for you!
Ohohoho! Cheeky little girls need to be punished!
Take that! And that!
Make fun of me and you'll regret it!
Now I'll take my sweet time torturing you to death!
Ohohohoho!
What'll ye be needin'?
Which one'll it be?
Nobody can equip that, y'know.
Will ye be equippin' it?
Who'll be equippin' it?
Which one should come off?
Thank ye kindly... Namu...
How many'll ye be sellin'?
A cross? This is it!
Just like the shape I read about in Musashi's books...
What's this? Some Christian ritual tool...?
A cross...? A Christian...
This? A decoration shaped like a cross?
It must be something the Christians hold dear...
But why would Amakusa Shiro, a Christian, sell his soul to Hell?
Jesus! A holy cross!
But... if Amakusa's any kind of Christian at all...
...why would he do something like this...
Lady Toki... Tch, what do you want?!
Lady Toki? But why are you here?
The Santa Maria statue is... shining?
What? That Maria statue thing?!
What's shining is...
...the Santa Maria statue!
The Sky Castle?! What the heck is that?
The Sky Castle?! I wonder why...
Hearing that name fills me with dread...
Sky Castle?! A castle that moves?
I don't get it at all!
Hurry, this way!
...For crying out loud!
Let's run!
Dangerous! Let's get out of here!
I see... Now things are getting interesting!
...But... I don't understand...
Nothing... I understand nothing...
What am I... doing?
And this place is...?
Why am I in a place like this?
Being here makes my heart ache, somehow... and yet...
...at the same time, I feel at peace...
Oh... nothing, nothing makes sense...
{NAME}! That earthquake just now was no ordinary quake!
My blood's boiling in a weird way...
Let's hurry!
Oh... how frightening!
Nature is letting out a terrible scream!
Let's hurry!
This is NO GOOD...
Amakusa must've started something terrible!
Anyway, let's get above ground!
Cough... That earthquake worries me...
And Lady Toki said something ominous too...
Let us hurry!
That earthquake was super weird!
I bet Amakusa's up to no good again!
{NAME}! Let's hurry up top!
Hmph... So Amakusa has started something...
Heh heh... Now it's getting interesting.
...{NAME}, could this quake be Amakusa's doing?
Let's hurry up top before it's too late!
Things don't seem to be going well...
In any case, let us hurry to the surface!
...I can hear nature screaming.
We have to hurry!
Something terrible is about to happen!
I'm the Red Kuroko, a kuroko in red...
For 100GP per person, I'll fully restore your HP and spirit...
1560.question: Get fully restored?

pages: Doesn't look like... a demon, though...
He's not... a demon, is he?
A demon...!? NO, he's not.
A demon... no...
Hm... So he's not a demon.
Who's that guy?
What the heck was that...?
The way he moves... He's no ordinary man...
...He's skilled... Who is he?
But... the power of that cursed Holy Bell...
...is not to be underestimated! Rrrggh...
What?! Say that again!
My name is Reon!
Reon the Gale!
I can't waste time dawdling with a low-level demon like this!
I'm going after the next Animus Bell!
Rrrrgggghhh! I will remember this!
With my own hands, I will surely...
...devour you all amid despair and terror!
Until then, temper your souls as best you can!
Rrrrgggghhh! Humans with big mouths!
Rrrrgggghhh!
Can't get down to the bottom of the crater, y'know.
Not from here, 'less there's some secret passage.
And this is Ukyo!
Rrrrgh! Fools who dare defy the demon realm!
...Now, I shall devour your souls!
After that, I will turn Kyushu into a sea of fire... Rrrrgggh...
Damn! Turn Kyushu into a sea of fire?!
Demon scum... I won't let that happen!
But... there's no way we can get down to the bottom of the crater.
How horrible... Destroying the nature of Kyushu... I won't allow it!
But what can we do? We can't get down to the bottom.
SHIT! I, Galford, won't let these demons get away with their schemes!
BUT even a ninja like me can't get down there...
...So, what now...
The eruption of Mount Aso... We cannot let it pass.
...But... it seems we cannot descend to the crater floor... Hmm.
Hmph... So the demons are scheming.
I don't care what happens to Aso or anything else...
...but I won't get dragged down with it...
Darn it!
Demons think up the craziest stuff!
We gotta beat that guy fast or it'll be real bad!
But... even Pak Pak can't go down...
...all the way there! What do we do?!
